The '''''Telgordo's Pride''''' was a [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] operated by [[Telgordo Travel/Legends|Telgordo Travel]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was hijacked by a rebel group led by the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Rutralli Optor]].
